rca_of_issue: Root cause: gradle-wrapper.jar (43705 bytes) was excluded from version control (likely by a broad *.jar rule in .gitignore), so a fresh CI checkout had gradlew + gradle-wrapper.properties but no bootstrap JAR. Running ./gradlew therefore raised java.lang.ClassNotFoundException: org.gradle.wrapper.GradleWrapperMain before compilation. Fix: (a) commit the jar; (b) add explicit '!**/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar' unignore rule; (c) harden the gate script to regenerate the wrapper (pinned Gradle 8.13) and assert GradleWrapperMain.class is inside the jar. Verified by simulating the CI checkout via `git clone /app /tmp/gd-clone` and running `./gradlew --version` from the fresh clone — succeeds with 'Gradle 8.13'.
